COURT’S OR JUDGES’S 
BA1 No. 244 of 2026
Rahul Mehra ....Applicant
Vs. 
State of Uttarakhand ......Respondent
Hon’ble Ashish Naithani, J.
Mr. D.C. S. Rawat, learned counsel for the Applicant. 
2. Mr. Vipul Painuly, learned A.G.A. for the State of 
Uttarakhand. 
3. Learned counsel for the Applicant submits that the present 
case pertains to an offence of murder; however, there are no direct 
eye-witnesses to the alleged incident. It is further contended that, 
thus far, only five prosecution witnesses have been examined, and 
the so-called eye-witnesses examined to date have not supported the 
prosecution version and have turned hostile. Learned counsel for the 
Applicant, therefore, seeks time to place on record the certified 
copies of the statements of the remaining witnesses in support of the 
bail application.
4. List this case on 02.05.2026.
 (Ashish Naithani, J.) 
 21.04.2026
